definitions.text: LeanDojo is a Lean theorem-proving benchmark and data-extraction ecosystem used as a comparison point for premise-based theorem proving.
A benchmark/dataset for evaluating language-model-based theorem provers on Lean theorem proving problems, including a novel-premises test subset.

relationships.evidence: Recent neural theorem provers are domain-agnostic and evaluated on benchmarks targeting this level [Level 3, proving simple theorems automatically in a domain-general fashion], e.g., CoqGym (Yang & Deng, 2019), LeanDojo (Yang et al., 2023), MiniF2F (Zheng et al., 2022), and PutnamBench (Tsoukalas et al., 2024). (Section 5.2)
